blind_spots_patched: Original Chapters 2–3 relied on management's qualitative 'rotating pool of 25–30 accounts' and 'multi-sourced OEM' framing without quantifying exact top-5 customer share, top-3 supplier share, single-distributor routing of strategic AI orders, unhedged FX payables, or India's addressable HPC market ceiling.

Original Chapters 3 & 6 emphasized quarter-end net cash (₹13.6 crore) and missed the 3.46x expansion of rated bank facilities, non-fund bank-guarantee exposure, 26x YoY surge in quarterly finance costs, GCA stretch to 268 days, and rapid 40-day consumption of ~64% of the ₹1,200 crore QIP.

Original Chapter 6 dismissed promoter stake reduction as 'small promoter sales' and omitted the upcoming February 2027 expiry of the promoters' 12-month no-dilution commitment as well as the September 2026 AGM approval of profit-linked promoter commissions.

Original Chapters 3–4 framed PLI IT Hardware qualification as a rare domestic moat without disclosing the full competitive field of 27 approved PLI 2.0 IT Hardware manufacturers localising servers in India.
